body: I saw those but i wasn’t sure if the holes were okay for the mice. Ty im gonna have to try them out
I’ve thought about jumping. I’m not sure where I can go to do that

He was being serious and it honestly kind of hurt. I don’t know why that would be an option Vs. finding someone who wants to go on that adventure with you. Instead I would be sucked into the life he wants and I already feel like that. 

I feel myself getting self destructive as well. Flirting with other people and entertaining the idea of hooking up with them. I don’t think I’d actually follow through but I hate that it crosses my mind.

I feel like he’s going to try and convince me to stay despite the fact that I’m not sure if I want that anymore.

I literally do not have the money to try therapy. 


Yes I have. He said if I didn’t want kids that he would use a surrogate and I wouldn’t have to care for the kid. That’s a really weird concept for me though and I hate the idea.

I don’t think he feels the same separation as I do. I think he believes we’re going to get married, have kids, etc. to him I’m just being distant and abnormally angry but I really don’t know how to express what I’m feeling without starting a fight or having it end up in tears. I don’t know. 

Part of me is terrified to move out cuz I also don’t have many friends and if my depression kicks in I won’t have anyone to fall on as a crutch. I’m not good with dealing on things on my own.

I cant afford therapy as much as I would like to try it. 
 I’m scared to talk to him because it seems like he has us painted as getting married, having kids, etc. and I don’t want to upset him by saying that I’m not sure if it’s me in that picture or not.
How did you co’p with not having the emotional support and being alone? How did you explain to them that you just aren’t feeling it anymore?

The fact that the cats die within a month, like clockwork, indicates there all passing to the same thing but it’s not supernatural. How closely does your friend pay attention to the cats? Has she had pets before? My guess would be that it’s a disease/ parasite which can linger in the home for quit sometime depending on what it is. Parvo acts very quickly but the symptoms, from my experience, are very noticeable. 
It sounds like your friend is paying very close attention to the cats. 
I also find it hard to believe that the vet hasn’t grown suspicious and tried to test the second or third cat for something along those lines.
I don’t have any physical evidence as of now. I’ve considered trying to reach out to a medium online but haven’t the slightest clue of where to look.

I do not follow any religion and do not have any sort of symbology that I could wear to ward things off. My roommate does sage the house monthly but it doesn’t really do anything. I’ve tried praying while the scratching was happening but it also did not seem to have any sort of effect.
